en-US.description:
Multiple dictionaries, one page.

Type a Pāḷi or Sanskrit word once and read every entry side by side: dictionaries, glossaries and canon definitions in a single answer. No tab juggling, no app switching.

PĀḶI LETTERS ON THE KEYBOARD
ā ī ū ṁ ṅ ñ ṭ ḍ ṇ ḷ and more sit right on top of the keyboard, with a Paste key. Turn the row off in the menu if you don't need it.

WORKS OFFLINE
The app opens with no network. Download the compact offline dictionary once, and short meanings keep working on a plane or in a retreat.

YOUR DICTIONARY ON ANY SITE
Reading a sutta, an article, a forum post? Select the word, tap Share, choose Dict.DG, and the full answer opens right there. The same lookup works as a browser extension and on the web.

FOUR WAYS TO TYPE
Pāḷi with diacritics and autocomplete, Velthuis (kacchapaa gives kacchapā), English, or Russian. Type the word however you already have it.

GRAMMAR YOU CAN ACTUALLY READ
Declension and conjugation tables sort themselves: tap a column header to order by case, number or gender.

STRAIGHT FROM THE CANON
Alongside the dictionaries you get definitions and similes as the suttas and the Vinaya give them.

RECENT WORDS, ONE TAP AWAY
Your history and favourites in the app, and your last words in the icon's long-press menu on the Home Screen.

FIND ON THE PAGE, LIGHT AND DARK THEME, FONT SIZE

Interface in English and Russian. Free, no ads, no accounts, no tracking.

Part of the Dhamma.Gift project: https://dhamma.gift
